title: Provider
description: A provider endpoint that serves one or more models. Secrets are referenced, never stored in plaintext config.

api.description: Wire protocol dialect: openai, anthropic, google, azure, bedrock, ...

base_url.description: API base URL; omit to use the dialect default.

api_key.description: API key. Write-only, never returned or logged; prefer env.

env.description: Environment variables checked in order for the API key.

headers.description: Extra headers added to every request.

npm.description: SDK package for providers that require a JS runtime.

enabled.description: Disabled providers are skipped by routing.
